title: Hate speech and hate crimes: a data-driven study of evolving discourse around marginalized groups

bias_targets.methodology: Keyword filtering, semantic topic modeling (BERTopic), and rule-based sentiment analysis (VADER) of online discourse targeting Black, Asian, and Hispanic groups, combined with temporal correlation against offline FBI hate crime data and dynamic network analysis.

Keyword filtering, semantic topic modeling (BERTopic), and sentiment analysis (VADER) of online discourse targeting the LGBTQ+ community, combined with temporal correlation against offline FBI hate crime data and dynamic community detection in user networks.
Keyword filtering and semantic topic modeling (BERTopic) of online discourse targeting Jewish groups to analyze the frequency of targeted tweets relative to real-world events.
